[Flashback to Nazi Germany]
**** GERMAN with subtitles ****
NAZI NURSE: It sounds so close...
KRIEGER: And also to the east, which means...
NAZI NURSE: The Russians. So all is lost.
KRIEGER: You should leave now, and go west. You will be safe with the Americans.
NAZI NURSE: I would never leave you.
KRIEGER: What?
NAZI NURSE: I love you. Don't you know that?
KRIEGER: And I love you too, but...
NAZI NURSE: Doctor! I'm sorry. He's gone...
KRIEGER: The damn systemic shock! The only problem we could never solve! Well, at least he won't have to see the Russian Army march into Berlin.
NAZI GENERAL: Nor will you, Doctor...
KRIEGER: General, what a surprise.
NAZI GENERAL: [* laughing *] Yes, it has been a day for surprises. But no surprise there, I assume?
KRIEGER: No, we lost him to systemic shock. I could never find a solution.
NAZI GENERAL: Now that... that is a surprise. Especially for a brilliant scientist like...Aaron Leibowitz!
KRIEGER: [* gasps *]
NAZI GENERAL: Yes, by all accounts young Leibowitz was brilliant indeed. Adored by his students at Hamburg Polytechnic, admired by his colleagues, but then...
KRIEGER: In 1933 he was forced to resign his position. Because he was a Jew.
NAZI GENERAL: And then, according to our records, young Leibowitz died of Tuberculosis.
KRIEGER: Only to be reborn as Doctor Krieger. False papers for my birth, education, then it was easy enough to secure a position in the robotics program.
NAZI GENERAL: And then to convince the Fuhrer to finance this foolishness! Robot super soldiers! My god, you fool, you barely even made a robot cat!
SCHNUCKIPUTZI: Meow?
KRIEGER: I did create robot super-soldiers! And they would have been unstoppable!
NAZI NURSE: But they all died of systemic shock...
KRIEGER: No, they all died from carbolic acid injections.
NAZI GENERAL: What?!
NAZI NURSE: My god, the wasted lives!
NAZI GENERAL: Lives?! The wasted money! My God, you must have wasted millions!
KRIEGER: Yes! And every penny wasted was a penny not spent on rifles! On bullets! On bombs! On coal to send the freezing cattle-cars to the east!
NAZI GENERAL: Yes, yes, cue the violins... Do you have anything else to add?
KRIEGER: Only that I didn't just make cats.
NAZI GENERAL: What?
KRIEGER: [* whistles *]
CYBORG DOGS: [* growling *]
NAZI GENERAL: My God! God in heaven! Help me! Devil-dogs!
KRIEGER: Yeah, right? Action!
[dogs tearing apart Nazis]
KRIEGER: Holy shit...
NAZI NURSE: [* gasps, crying *]
KRIEGER: I'm sorry you had to see that... But we should go. The Russians will be here soon.
NAZI NURSE: Ha! I would prefer the Russians to a filthy Jew like you!
KRIEGER: Seriously?!
NAZI NURSE: [* spits *]
KRIEGER: Huh. Well then umm... Action?
[dogs growling woman screaming]
KRIEGER: Here, kitty! Oh.
SCHNUCKIPUTZI: [* meows *]
